I would say the only downsides is that its pretty tough to get a proper sear on steaks, everything else has turned out really well. the wifire has worked well for me, super nice to change/shut down the temperature remotely.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I have to say I had high hopes, but am extremely disappointed in the Traeger.   I do have some good things to say about it.  It is really easy to use for starters, which is probably the best thing about it. The WiFire is actually an awesome feature.   As far as cooking, if you want to use it as an oven it is pretty good.  It will do most things that any other oven can do.  However if you have expectations that this is going to be a grill or a smoker, don't buy it.  It sort of does both,  but very poorly.  If you are using it as a grill, the indirect heat just is not enough to get a sear on anything. And as a smoker,  well it will slow cook, but there is no smoke flavor. Like none. The only thing I have been able to get decent smoke flavor on is roasted vegetables.  Outside that there is no detectable smoke flavor on chicken, fish, beef or anything else I have tried on it.   I have had a host of other smokers, from charcoal, to propane, to electric, to straight wood.  all of them were a quarter the price of the traeger and all were far superior.  I had no expectations that it was going to match the wood fired smoker,  but it cant even come close to a cheap electric smoker.
Results.Title: Good if you want an outdoor oven.

She recently suggested we upgrade to a Traeger from our cheaply made Pit Boss pellet grill.  So the first thing I fixed were country style ribs. As soon as I put them on I had turned the temp to 160, we had leave to run into town.  The trip was longer than we had planned and I figured my ribs would be burnt to a crisp!  This pellet grill is amazing the ribs were done perfect, not dry, not burnt. The old saying you get what you pay for and this is by far well worth it! Results.ReviewText: I own a timberline 1300 and a lil tex.  After hearing all the hype over the Pro series I had to get my hands on one!! The wifire is so convenient especially with 3 kids so I am never near my smokers as much as I would like to be.  I can take time with the family while being able to monitor and change temps on my grill from anywhere!!! The D2 controller lets me calibrate probes, set timers, and keeps the turbo temp so good!! Traeger has turned me from a hardcore stick burner to a Traeger griller for life!! From whole hogs to oysters I have done everything on these grills and they are now basically my whole kitchen in one!!
Results.Title: Pro 780 D2 and wifire is freaking amazing!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I have been a Traeger customer for 25 years. The Pro Series 780 is my fourth Traeger grill. My other three are still functioning and have been passed down to friends and family. My wife and I love the WiFiRE technology allowing us to monitor and control cooking, grilling, smoking, and warming our preparations from inside the house and NOT have to open the grill to check the food.
Results.Title: 25 Years w/Traeger
